script: Now set up your free workspace. Step one: create one Gmail address that you use only for work. Use a clear name. Step two: install WhatsApp Business, which is free, and fill in your business name, your services and your working hours. Step three: create a free Canva account and a free Google Drive. Make four folders inside Drive: Learning, Portfolio, Clients and Invoices. Step four: set a phone reminder for your daily learning time, and keep a notebook beside you. Step five: tell your family your work hours. A short, clear agreement prevents most interruptions. Now, digital safety. Your accounts are your business, so protect them from day one. Use a strong password of at least twelve characters, and a different password for each service. Turn on two-step verification for Gmail, WhatsApp and any payment account. This sends a code to your phone when someone tries to log in. Many women think they need an expensive laptop before they can start.
glossary: Canva, WhatsApp Business, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Upwork, Fiverr, LinkedIn, CapCut, Payoneer, OTP, PIN, freelance, Facebook, Instagram
